author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

Follow-up (09/22/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works.

Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content:
Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both.

Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me.

See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each!

For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! Portraits for the time being, but if someone can pin down the perfect art style for the series, it’ll turn to more!

For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically! It’s a very visual world.

Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for campaign visuals
content:
Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer

Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for:
• Social media visuals
• Ads creatives
• Campaign posters
• Simple visual adaptations / resizing

Prefer someone who:
Has a good eye for clean & modern design
Can follow brand guidelines / references well
Responsive and able to meet deadlines
Comfortable handling ad & social media creatives

This will be freelance / project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects if we work well together.

If you’re interested, drop your portfolio + rate in the comments or DM me.

Contact: comment with portfolio and rate, or DM @yuanxin_289
